title: Predictions file - Task 1 (proposed default)
description: Default submission layout until Q-01 is answered (02 §6.3, 03 §2.5): one file per task, top-level array, each item has exactly sample_id and output; output repeats the output object of the task file. Matches Settings val.layout="array", val.output_style="nested", val.files="per_task". Internal metadata such as gate_source must never appear here. Checks that JSON Schema cannot express are listed in x-validator-only and enforced by val/validator.py before every upload.
x-validator-only: UTF-8 without BOM, valid JSON (FR-VAL-01, FR-VAL-04)
set of sample_id == input ids of the split; no missing, no extra, no duplicate (FR-VAL-01)
strict integers: reject 7.0 although JSON Schema 'integer' accepts it (FR-VAL-04)
total_score == sum of the 6 rubric values (BR-01)

sample_id.description: No pattern on purpose: the EX..-S... shape is only observed on 32 samples [GT] and must not block a private file; the id set is checked against the input ids (validator rule 4, 06 §5).
